name: Sorin Grindeanu
why: Calls for higher taxation of large fortunes; confirm whether proposed base includes net wealth rather than property or income.
note: The contemporaneous PSD package specifies taxes on expensive houses and cars; no net-wealth tax established for this particular lead. Reopen for different qualifying evidence.

name: Partidul Social Democrat
why: Party proposal to tax large fortunes; identify actual policy design.
note: The contemporaneous PSD package specifies taxes on expensive houses and cars; no net-wealth tax established for this particular lead. Reopen for different qualifying evidence.

name: Constantin Dascălu
why: Supports a wealth tax in principle during 2012 debate but rejects Surupăceanu bill and references UNPR alternative; confirm whether his preferred design includes net wealth.
note: The official debate records general support but opposition to this bill; the separately cited UNPR alternative covered buildings and luxury assets. His preferred tax base is not established.

name: Sebastian Buhai
why: Proposes progressive net asset taxation but the article appears to tax financial assets only when gains are realized; clarify the taxable base and timing.
note: Article explicitly excludes taxation of financial assets in advance, leaving its proposed wealth tax design ambiguous.

name: Blocul pentru Locuire
why: Coalition calls for taxing large fortunes; verify whether its capital-tax proposal includes a stock of wealth rather than income or real estate alone.
note: The manifesto calls for progressive taxation of income, capital and profit and large property owners; a 2020 memorandum summary also references fortunes and profits of real-estate businesses and banks. Asset base remains ambiguous.

name: Blocul Suveranist Român
why: Party policy page endorses a tax on total wealth above €10m; determine a defensible publication or adoption date.
note: 2023-11-25 reporting identifies a seven-party alliance with this name and a same-name member party; alliance principles mention taxation of large fortunes without defining the base. The party website independently describes an annual tax on total wealth but displays no publication date.
